description: Example data-driven mod: makes the player's starting pistol hit harder and the lowest-tier guard a little tougher, and adds more health pickups on level 1. JSON values only — no code, no engine changes. WAD overlays are optional; this example ships none (see README.md). Values the engine only reads at load time take effect on the next level load; the JSON overrides are visible to the script layer immediately in window.RottModValues.

Guard.note: Stock guard health is lower; this makes the first guards take one more pistol hit.

E1L1.note: Four extra health pickups placed by the script layer / level logic on episode 1, level 1.

name: Double Damage (example)

Pistol.note: Stock pistol damage is lower; 40 roughly doubles it.
